sub_processes.name: Invoice Receipt
sub_processes.business_objective: Ensure all received invoices are captured completely and accurately

sub_processes.name: Invoice Approval
sub_processes.business_objective: Ensure only valid, authorized invoices are approved for payment

sub_processes.name: Payment
sub_processes.business_objective: Ensure only approved invoices are paid, once, to the correct beneficiary

walkthrough.speaker: owner
walkthrough.utterance: When an invoice comes in it lands in a shared mailbox, and someone in AP keys it into the ERP and matches it to the PO and the goods receipt.

capture.risk_description: Invoices received outside the system may bypass controls and go unrecorded
capture.control_description: Central mailbox intake with three-way match before posting

walkthrough.speaker: owner
walkthrough.utterance: The duplicate-payment check is automatic; the system blocks anything with the same supplier, amount and date.

capture.risk_description: Duplicate or fraudulent invoices may be approved for payment
capture.control_description: System-generated duplicate-payment check on supplier + amount + date

walkthrough.speaker: owner
walkthrough.utterance: For approvals, honestly, it's whoever is around. There's no hard segregation between who raises the PO and who approves it.

capture.risk_description: Invoices may be approved without segregation of duties from the PO initiator

walkthrough.speaker: owner
walkthrough.utterance: Payments go out in a weekly run. To be honest nobody double-checks the beneficiary bank details before release.

capture.risk_description: Payments may be released to unauthorized or duplicate beneficiaries
